description: Application top bar with brand area, center content slot, action buttons, an opt-in navigation disclosure button, a command palette trigger with its key chord, and an account menu (APG menu with host entries and a localized sign out).

parameters.name: ShowMenuButton
parameters.description: Renders the navigation disclosure button that opens the host's navigation drawer (mobile navigation, a collapsible rail). Default false: no button, the bar is unchanged.

parameters.name: MenuExpanded
parameters.description: Whether the navigation the menu button toggles is currently open — reported as aria-expanded on the button. The host owns the state (this component never changes it).

parameters.name: OnMenuToggle
parameters.description: Fires when the navigation disclosure button is clicked.

parameters.name: MenuControlsId
parameters.description: Id of the element the menu button controls (the host's navigation drawer), reported as aria-controls. Null omits the attribute.

parameters.name: CommandPaletteShortcut
parameters.description: The key chord printed in the command palette trigger ("Ctrl+K"). It is a label, not a keybinding — the host binds the shortcut. An empty string hides the hint and keeps the localized accessible name; what the trigger announces to assistive technology is CommandPaletteKeyShortcuts.

parameters.name: CommandPaletteKeyShortcuts
parameters.description: The aria-keyshortcuts value of the command palette trigger — the chord the host actually binds, in the space-separated ARIA syntax. Defaults to "Control+K Meta+K", the chord the default hint documents; a host that rebinds the palette passes its own value here so the announcement cannot contradict the printed hint. Null or empty omits the attribute.

parameters.name: User
parameters.description: Currently logged-in user. When set, renders user avatar and menu.

parameters.name: UserMenuItems
parameters.description: Entries of the account menu, above the built-in sign out. A UserMenuItem with Href renders as a link, one with OnClick as a command, Separator as a group separator and IsDanger in the destructive style. Null renders no host entries.

parameters.name: UserMenuLabel
parameters.description: Accessible name of the account button and of its menu. Null (the default) uses the localized "User menu"; a host with more than one account surface names this one ("Signed-in account").

parameters.name: OnCommandPalette
parameters.description: Fires when the command palette trigger is clicked.

parameters.name: OnLogout
parameters.description: Fires when the user clicks the sign-out entry of the account menu.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the root element.

parameters.name: IsLandmark
parameters.description: When true (the default) the root is a header element — a banner landmark, which is what the application bar is. Pass false when the bar is composed into an application frame that owns the page landmarks (TmAppShell): the root then renders as a plain div inside the frame's own header, so the page never carries a banner nested in a banner.

examples.title: Top bar with brand, user, and command palette
Top bar with custom center content
Top bar with a navigation drawer toggle and an account menu
examples.code:
<TmTopBar BrandTitle="Admin"
          ShowMenuButton="true"
          MenuExpanded="drawerOpen"
          MenuControlsId="app-drawer"
          OnMenuToggle="() => drawerOpen = !drawerOpen"
          User="currentUser"
          UserMenuItems="accountItems"
          OnLogout="HandleLogout" />

usedAbstractions.name: UserMenuItem
usedAbstractions.description: Model representing one entry of the account menu
